title: 第13章 会骑马的狗第14章 天机阁忘天机
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: 第13章会骑马的狗伴随着柳家家主的分析，柳梦妍和柳乘风两个人也是松了一口气。
“这陈家，还真是诡计多端，真的差一点就被他们骗了。”
“耽误了我的大好姻缘，看我怎么教训他们。”
“父亲，这件事情，绝对不能善罢甘休。”
“契约还在陈家，我担心他们会在我订婚之时跑来捣乱。”柳梦妍气愤的说道。
“此事不难。”
“梦妍，你和五皇子情投意合，而五皇子的舅父，正是你们上清宗的三长老，实力强横。”
“只要你将此事告知五皇子，让他舅父出手，陈家必然翻不起什么风浪。”柳家家主笑着说道。
大周皇室和上清宗关系十分的密切，整体实力来说，上清宗更强，但上清宗如今的太上长老，乃是大周皇室之人。
双方千丝万缕的关系，若是皇室有难，上清宗不可能坐视不理。
而五皇子的舅父又是上清宗的长老，实力颇为强悍。
“父亲，只要告诉五皇子就可以吗？”
“陛下那边……”
“梦妍，这件事情知道的人有，但大家不说，知道为什么吗？”
“皇室也是要颜面的。”
“这也是为什么当时我让你们两人单独过去陈家一趟的原因。”
“这件事情，知道的人越少越好。”
“原来如此，还是父亲您考虑的深远，那我现在就去找五皇子。”
“好，尽量快一点解决掉陈家这个隐患，以免夜长梦多。”
柳家这边有行动，陈家那边，同样没有继续留在燕归城。
“你们快看，这也太奇怪了吧？”
“我去，这种情况，我还是第一次见到。”
“这……我是不是还没睡醒？我在做梦吧？”
“妈的，狗都骑马了？”
“活得不如狗，我都没钱买一匹马。”
“这两位，又是哪家的少爷？”
三日之前，陈长安带着陈云轩和大黄离开了燕归城，这一路但凡是有人的地方，着实吸引了不少的注意。
无关其他，就是因为大黄非要骑马。
狗骑马，闻所未闻，见所未见！
起初陈云轩还有些不太好意思，毕竟他也没有试过被这么多人关注和议论。
虽然火力集中点在大黄身上，但身为同行人员之一，陈云轩自然也逃不掉。
不过现在，陈云轩到也不怎么在意了，没办法，习惯的就是这么快！
“云轩，这里还找北原郡的范围之内吗？”陈长安问道。
“老祖，我其实没怎么离开过燕归城，不过按照路程来算的话，应该还在北原郡。”陈云轩想了想之后说道。
三天时间还没有离开北原郡，这速度未免慢了一些。
“大黄，都是你，非要骑马，不然的话，怎么会走的这么慢。”
content_en:
Chapter 13 The Riding Dog Following the analysis of the head of the Liu family, Liu Mengyan and Liu Chengfeng also breathed a sigh of relief.
"This Chen family is really cunning. I almost got deceived by them."
"They delayed my good marriage, let's see how I teach them a lesson."
"Father, this matter must not be let go."
"The contract is still with the Chen family. I'm worried that they will come and cause trouble when I get engaged." Liu Mengyan said angrily.
"It's not difficult."
"Mengyan, you and the fifth prince are in love, and the fifth prince's uncle is the third elder of your Shangqing Sect, and he is very powerful."
"As long as you inform the fifth prince about this and let his uncle take action, the Chen family will definitely not be able to cause any trouble." The head of the Liu family said with a smile.
The relationship between the Great Zhou royal family and the Shangqing sect is very close. In terms of overall strength, the Shangqing sect is stronger, but the current Supreme Elder of the Shangqing sect is a member of the Great Zhou royal family.
The relationship between the two parties is inextricably linked. If the royal family is in trouble, the Shangqing Sect cannot sit idly by and ignore it.
The uncle of the fifth prince is an elder of the Shangqing Sect and is quite powerful.
"Father, can you just tell the fifth prince?"
"Your Majesty's side..."
"Mengyan, there are people who know about this matter, but no one talks about it. Do you know why?"
"The royal family also cares about face."
"That's why I asked you two to go to Chen's house alone."
"The fewer people who know about this, the better."
"I see, Father, you are still thinking deeply, so I will go find the fifth prince now."
"Okay, try to solve this hidden danger in the Chen family as soon as possible to avoid long nights and dreams."
"Yes."
The Liu family took action, and the Chen family also did not continue to stay in Yangui City.
"Look, isn't this too strange?"
"I'll go. This is the first time I've seen this situation."
"This...am I not awake yet? Am I dreaming?"
“Damn it, the dogs are all on horses?”
"My life is worse than that of a dog. I don't even have the money to buy a horse."
"Which young master are these two from?"
Three days ago, Chen Changan left Yangui City with Chen Yunxuan and Dahuang. Wherever there were people along the way, it really attracted a lot of attention.
It has nothing to do with anything else, just because Dahuang insists on riding a horse.
Dog riding, unheard of, unseen!
At first, Chen Yunxuan was a little embarrassed. After all, he had never been paid attention to and discussed by so many people.
Although the firepower was focused on Dahuang, as one of the companions, Chen Yunxuan naturally could not escape.
But now, Chen Yunxuan doesn't care much anymore. He has no choice but to get used to it so quickly!
"Yunxuan, is this place still within the scope of Beiyuan County?" Chen Changan asked.
"Ancestor, I have actually never left Yangui City, but based on the distance, I should still be in Beiyuan County." Chen Yunxuan said after thinking for a while.
They haven't left Beiyuan County in three days, so this speed is a bit slow.
"Dahuang, it's all you. You have to ride a horse. Otherwise, why would you be walking so slowly?"
